name: Cloudflare
description: The Cloudflare account wrangler works in, for Workers dev servers. Wrangler has no machine-wide account switch (it reads account_id from the project's config or CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID), so pick it per profile; servers get CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

fields.label: Account
fields.list: wrangler whoami --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'const r = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); for (const a of r.accounts || []) console.log(a.id + "\t" + a.name)'

login.label: Sign in
login.description: Runs `wrangler login`; finish in the browser window that opens.
